mapper.select: SELECT id, category, title, description, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, version, download_count, uploaded_by, active, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_form_template WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT f.id, f.category, f.title, f.description, f.file_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.mime_type, f.version, f.download_count, f.uploaded_by, u.name AS uploader_name, f.active, f.created_at FROM tb_form_template f LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = f.uploaded_by AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted = 0

SELECT f.id, f.category, f.title, f.description, f.file_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.mime_type, f.version, f.download_count, f.uploaded_by, u.name AS uploader_name, f.active, f.created_at FROM tb_form_template f LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = f.uploaded_by AND u.deleted = 0
ORDER BY f.category, f.title OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_form_template ( category, title, description, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, version, download_count, uploaded_by, active, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{category}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{version}, 0, #{uploadedBy}, #{active}1, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_form_template SET download_count = ISNULL(download_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_form_template SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
